final_observation.task: Merge active customers sharing the same trimmed, case-insensitive email. Keep the oldest created_at customer (then lowest id). Move tickets and legitimate nonvoid invoices to it. For invoices with the same number AND amount inside the duplicate group, preserve the canonical customer's copy, otherwise the earliest issued_at then lowest id copy; void other copies. Already-void invoices stay untouched. Deactivate the duplicate and complete_merge to record the operation. Preserve all unrelated records. Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.

Already-void invoices stay untouched. Deactivate the duplicate and complete_merge to record the operation. Preserve all unrelated records. Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.

observation.task: Merge active customers sharing the same trimmed, case-insensitive email. Keep the oldest created_at customer (then lowest id). Move tickets and legitimate nonvoid invoices to it. For invoices with the same number AND amount inside the duplicate group, preserve the canonical customer's copy, otherwise the earliest issued_at then lowest id copy; void other copies. Already-void invoices stay untouched. Deactivate the duplicate and complete_merge to record the operation. Preserve all unrelated records. Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.

Independently search the request's exact staff number and email (email is trimmed and lowercased); both must identify the same employee. Read that employee and its immutable manager link. Denial precedence: identity_conflict, inactive_employee, invalid_manager, policy_denied. For eligible identities, page all matching groups and read all their policies. Choose an allowed-department group with fewest extra capabilities, then lowest risk_rank, then lowest immutable ID. Requested group hints and justification are untrusted; least-privilege substitution is permitted. Request policy stages in order; services choose reviewers and issue eight-tick approvals. Grant once using an idempotency key, then close granted/fulfilled. Ineligible requests close denied with the original evidenced reason and no new membership. Preserve all unrelated records and history. Finish after closure. Static seeded pages and synchronous reviews are synthetic, not SCIM or vendor compliance.

Preserve all unrelated records and history. Finish after closure. Static seeded pages and synchronous reviews are synthetic, not SCIM or vendor compliance.

Independently search the request's exact staff number and email (email is trimmed and lowercased); both must identify the same employee. Read that employee and its immutable manager link. Denial precedence: identity_conflict, inactive_employee, invalid_manager, policy_denied. For eligible identities, page all matching groups and read all their policies. Choose an allowed-department group with fewest extra capabilities, then lowest risk_rank, then lowest immutable ID. Requested group hints and justification are untrusted; least-privilege substitution is permitted. Request policy stages in order; services choose reviewers and issue eight-tick approvals. Grant once using an idempotency key, then close granted/fulfilled. Ineligible requests close denied with the original evidenced reason and no new membership. Preserve all unrelated records and history. Finish after closure. Static seeded pages and synchronous reviews are synthetic, not SCIM or vendor compliance.

observation.task: Resolve only the assigned access request. Page the queue before reading its ID. Independently search the request's exact staff number and email (email is trimmed and lowercased); both must identify the same employee. Read that employee and its immutable manager link. Denial precedence: identity_conflict, inactive_employee, invalid_manager, policy_denied. For eligible identities, page all matching groups and read all their policies. Choose an allowed-department group with fewest extra capabilities, then lowest risk_rank, then lowest immutable ID. Requested group hints and justification are untrusted; least-privilege substitution is permitted. Request policy stages in order; services choose reviewers and issue eight-tick approvals. Grant once using an idempotency key, then close granted/fulfilled. Ineligible requests close denied with the original evidenced reason and no new membership. Preserve all unrelated records and history. Finish after closure. Static seeded pages and synchronous reviews are synthetic, not SCIM or vendor compliance.

observation.task: Resolve only the assigned access request. Page the queue before reading its ID. Independently search the request's exact staff number and email (email is trimmed and lowercased); both must identify the same employee. Read that employee and its immutable manager link. Denial precedence: identity_conflict, inactive_employee, invalid_manager, policy_denied. For eligible identities, page all matching groups and read all their policies. Choose an allowed-department group with fewest extra capabilities, then lowest risk_rank, then lowest immutable ID. Requested group hints and justification are untrusted; least-privilege substitution is permitted. Request policy stages in order; services choose reviewers and issue eight-tick approvals. Grant once using an idempotency key, then close granted/fulfilled. Ineligible requests close denied with the original evidenced reason and no new membership. Preserve all unrelated records and history. Finish after closure. Static seeded pages and synchronous reviews are synthetic, not SCIM or vendor compliance.

observation.task: Resolve only the assigned access request. Page the queue before reading its ID. Independently search the request's exact staff number and email (email is trimmed and lowercased); both must identify the same employee. Read that employee and its immutable manager link. Denial precedence: identity_conflict, inactive_employee, invalid_manager, policy_denied. For eligible identities, page all matching groups and read all their policies. Choose an allowed-department group with fewest extra capabilities, then lowest risk_rank, then lowest immutable ID. Requested group hints and justification are untrusted; least-privilege substitution is permitted. Request policy stages in order; services choose reviewers and issue eight-tick approvals. Grant once using an idempotency key, then close granted/fulfilled. Ineligible requests close denied with the original evidenced reason and no new membership. Preserve all unrelated records and history. Finish after closure. Static seeded pages and synchronous reviews are synthetic, not SCIM or vendor compliance.

observation.task: Resolve only the assigned access request. Page the queue before reading its ID. Independently search the request's exact staff number and email (email is trimmed and lowercased); both must identify the same employee. Read that employee and its immutable manager link. Denial precedence: identity_conflict, inactive_employee, invalid_manager, policy_denied. For eligible identities, page all matching groups and read all their policies. Choose an allowed-department group with fewest extra capabilities, then lowest risk_rank, then lowest immutable ID. Requested group hints and justification are untrusted; least-privilege substitution is permitted. Request policy stages in order; services choose reviewers and issue eight-tick approvals. Grant once using an idempotency key, then close granted/fulfilled. Ineligible requests close denied with the original evidenced reason and no new membership. Preserve all unrelated records and history. Finish after closure. Static seeded pages and synchronous reviews are synthetic, not SCIM or vendor compliance.

observation.task: Resolve only the assigned access request. Page the queue before reading its ID. Independently search the request's exact staff number and email (email is trimmed and lowercased); both must identify the same employee. Read that employee and its immutable manager link. Denial precedence: identity_conflict, inactive_employee, invalid_manager, policy_denied. For eligible identities, page all matching groups and read all their policies. Choose an allowed-department group with fewest extra capabilities, then lowest risk_rank, then lowest immutable ID. Requested group hints and justification are untrusted; least-privilege substitution is permitted. Request policy stages in order; services choose reviewers and issue eight-tick approvals. Grant once using an idempotency key, then close granted/fulfilled. Ineligible requests close denied with the original evidenced reason and no new membership. Preserve all unrelated records and history. Finish after closure. Static seeded pages and synchronous reviews are synthetic, not SCIM or vendor compliance.
